method.selection_policy: LLM-selected market-relevant items from news_digest.json; preserves source metadata and excludes noise.

framework.Equities: Broad equity/risk sentiment; market-moving mega-cap/AI allowed; low-signal single-stock noise excluded.
framework.Commodities: Physical commodity futures framework; supply disruption/demand strength positive; supply increase/demand weakness negative.
framework.FX: USD-centric basket; non-USD currency strength positive; USD/DXY strength negative.
framework.Rates: Bond-price framework; yields up/selloff/higher-for-longer negative; yields down/bond rally/cooler inflation positive.

Equities.title: TRADING DAY War on, risk-off: Stocks drop, crude jumps as Trump calls Iran peace deal 'over'
Equities.reason: Direct market-impact headline: renewed US-Iran tensions and crude jump = clear risk-off impulse for equities. High relevance as macro/geopolitical driver dominates market sentiment.

Equities.title: Asian shares climb on chip rally, oil jumps as Gulf hostilities resume
Equities.reason: Mixed signal: chip-led sector strength lifts Asian indices but Gulf hostilities and oil spike create downside risk — marginally negative for broad equities but shows dispersion.

Equities.title: Morning Bid: Chip euphoria vies with war weariness
Equities.reason: Sums up the dominant regime clash: strong chip/AI leadership versus escalating geopolitical risk. Balanced but leans negative for market breadth; relevant for daily positioning.

Equities.title: Equities: Stagflation hit and chip-sector divergence – Deutsche Bank
Equities.summary: Deutsche Bank strategists report that United States (US) equities weakened under a stagflationary backdrop. The S&P 500 fell with broad-based losses, while the Philly semiconductor index outperformed strongly.
Equities.reason: Analyst view highlighting stagflationary pressure (negative for broad equities) alongside chip outperformance — reinforces narrative of market-wide weakness with narrow leadership.

Equities.title: Asian investors eye firms benefiting from but resilient to AI
Equities.reason: Flows-focused piece: investor demand for AI beneficiaries supports sector leadership (positive for tech/chips) and explains pockets of resilience amid broader risk-off.

Equities.title: Few bright spots in Wednesday's tough market — why Nvidia stock is one of them
Equities.summary: Every weekday, the Investing Club releases the Homestretch; an actionable afternoon update just in time for the last hour of trading.
Equities.reason: Company/sector-level note: Nvidia as a defensive leadership name inside a weak market — supports narrow, AI-led risk preference but limited broad-market transmission.

Equities.title: SK Hynix US listing more than seven times oversubscribed, source says
Equities.reason: Strong IPO demand for a major memory/chip name signals robust investor appetite for semiconductor exposure — positive for tech/chip leadership and market risk-on in that segment.

Equities.title: U.S. begins new Iran strikes after closing bell on Wall Street
Equities.reason: Geopolitical escalation after US market close is a high-impact shock for risk assets; fuels oil risk premium and reinforces risk-off regime for equities.

Rates.title: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.summary: Minutes of the Federal Open Market Committee, June 16-17, 2026
Rates.reason: Primary source showing Fed deliberations. Minutes signalled sustained inflation concern and disagreement on rate path, raising odds of less imminent cuts or further tightening — pushes yields up (negative for bonds) and materially shifts rates outlook.

Rates.title: US Dollar: Supported by higher yields and FOMC stance – MUFG
Rates.summary: MUFG’s Lloyd Chan reports that June Federal Open Market Committee (FOMC) minutes show policymakers increasingly concerned that US inflation could stay elevated, with some seeing a case for a rate hike.
Rates.reason: Market note linking FOMC minutes to USD strength via higher yields. Reinforces bond-selloff narrative as participants reprice rate-cut timing and potential for tighter policy.

Rates.title: Fed policymakers' inflation worries weighed on rate cut outlook at Warsh's first meeting
Rates.reason: Headline indicates Fed officials' inflation concerns are pushing back on rate-cut expectations — higher-for-longer narrative that keeps upward pressure on yields (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Fed officials were split on direction of interest rates at last meeting, minutes show
Rates.summary: The Federal Reserve on Wednesday released minutes from its June 16-17 meeting.
Rates.reason: Market coverage emphasises internal Fed split and uncertainty about cuts. Heightens volatility and keeps yields biased higher as markets push back expected easing.

Rates.title: Japan benchmark bond yield hits 30-year high on inflation, fiscal health concerns
Rates.reason: Direct evidence of a material rise in JGB yields on inflation and fiscal worries. Significant regional rate move that tightens global conditions and pressure on fixed income markets (negative for bond prices).

Rates.title: Japan’s Five-Year Bond Sale Sees Decent Demand on Higher Yields
Rates.reason: Primary market data showing auctions clearing at higher yields. Confirms market absorption but within a higher-yield environment — modestly negative for bond prices overall.

Rates.title: High Yields Set Stage for More Global Bond Inflow Into Indonesia
Rates.reason: High nominal yields in Indonesia are attracting global bond demand, supporting local bond prices/flows. This is a localized positive for bond markets (inflow into EM fixed income) even as global yields rise.

Rates.title: China consumer price growth weakens in June while producer inflation rises to near 4-year high
Rates.summary: Investors increasingly view China's two-speed growth with robust export and tepid domestic demand as a defining long-term feature of the Chinese economy.
Rates.reason: PPI strength alongside softer CPI implies cost pressures in China that can feed global inflation expectations and keep yields elevated; modest negative for bond prices.

Rates.title: China's producer inflation hits near 4-year high in June, squeezing manufacturers
Rates.reason: Reuters report of rising PPI in China reinforces inflationary signal from a major economy, supporting a higher-for-longer global rates narrative and pressuring bond prices.

Rates.title: Investors get inflation 'wake-up call' as Trump fires up oil prices
Rates.reason: Oil-driven inflation scare boosts inflation expectations and yields; important macro channel pushing bond yields higher and weighing on fixed income.

Rates.title: Live markets: Bitcoin drops to $62,000 as oil and bond yields surge on collapse of Iran ceasefire
Rates.reason: Market snapshot linking geopolitical shock to simultaneous oil and bond-yield jumps. Reinforces risk of quick repricing of rates higher (negative for bonds).

Rates.title: Bank of Japan may speed up rate hikes, pushing borrowing costs above 2%, ex-BOJ official warns
Rates.reason: Commentary that BoJ could accelerate tightening implies materially higher JGB yields ahead — negative for bond prices and relevant to global rates spillovers.

Rates.title: BOK’s Shin Sees Need for Rate Hike Ahead of Next Week’s Meeting
Rates.reason: Korea signalling an imminent hike adds to regional tightening bias and contributes to upward pressure on regional yields (negative for bond prices).

FX.title: Euro: Early gains against US Dollar at risk on Fed story – ING
FX.summary: Chris Turner at ING highlights that EUR/USD has held up despite higher Oil, as Euro swap rates outperformed US rates on expectations of an ECB hike in September. However, he argues the Fed narrative will dominate, with EUR/USD likely to surrender gains and fal
FX.reason: Macro note arguing Fed narrative (USD strength) will dominate EUR moves. High relevance because it highlights cross-market rate differentials (ECB vs Fed) and a USD-dominant story shaping EUR/USD.

FX.title: USD/CHF Price Forecast: Dollar bulls lose steam after rejection at 0.8100
FX.summary: The US Dollar is trading lower against the Swiss Franc (CHF) on Thursday, as investors ponder the consequences of reciprocal US and Iran attacks and a 10% rebound in Oil prices, on the major central banks' monetary policies.
FX.reason: Pair-level technical/price-forecast piece showing USD losing steam versus CHF amid geopolitics and oil — a USD-weakness signal. Relevance capped at 0.8 because it's a technical/forecast note rather than a major policy shock.

FX.title: Euro: Hawkish Fed keeps gains contained against US Dollar – Commerzbank
FX.summary: Thu Lan Nguyen at Commerzbank notes that EUR/USD has traded in a narrow range and appears largely unaffected by Iran-related headlines, as the correlation with Oil has weakened.
FX.reason: Bank analysis attributing limited EUR upside to a hawkish Fed — reinforces USD-dominant narrative vs EUR. Relevant for cross-rate flows and policy-driven FX moves.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index stays pressured near 101.00 as Fed bets/Iran risks limit losses
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, trades with a negative bias for the second straight day, though it remains confined within the previous day's range through the Asian session on Thursday.
FX.reason: Direct DXY/ USD-basket update showing a negative bias (USD weakness) but constrained by Fed bets and Iran risks. High relevance because DXY moves transmit across all USD pairs.

FX.title: United States Dollar Index Price Forecast: Flirts with 23.6% Fibo./weekly low below 101.00
FX.summary: The US Dollar Index (DXY), which tracks the Greenback against a basket of currencies, extends the previous day's pullback from the 101.25-101.30 region and attracts some follow-through sellers on Thursday.
FX.reason: DXY technical/price forecast showing continued pullback. High relevance as it reinforces a USD-weakness theme with potential follow-through across major USD pairs.

FX.title: New Zealand Dollar advances above 0.5700 on RBNZ hawkish stance
FX.summary: The NZD/USD pair gains momentum to around 0.5735 during the early European session on Thursday. The New Zealand Dollar (NZD) strengthens against the US Dollar (USD) on a hawkish interest rate hike from the Reserve Bank of New Zealand (RBNZ).
FX.reason: Central-bank-driven currency move: RBNZ hikes and hawkish tone are a direct driver of NZD strength vs USD. High relevance as policy shifts reshape yield differentials and FX flows.

FX.title: Japanese Yen gains against US Dollar despite renewed geopolitical risks
FX.summary: The Japanese Yen (JPY) trades higher against the US Dollar (USD) despite renewed geopolitical risks.
FX.reason: Market action showing JPY strength versus USD despite risk events — a meaningful cross-market signal. Relevance moderate as JPY moves can reflect safe-haven and yield dynamics.

FX.title: AUD/USD Price Forecast: 0.6860 is key support level amid geopolitical risks
FX.summary: The Australian Dollar (AUD) trades marginally higher at around 0.6935 against the US Dollar (USD) during the European trading session on Thursday.
FX.reason: Pair-level technical forecast showing modest AUD strength versus USD amid geopolitics. Relevance capped at 0.8 because it's a price-forecast/technical piece.

FX.title: GBP/USD Price Forecast: Holds a constructive bullish tone above 1.3400 as UK political risk eases
FX.summary: The GBP/USD pair trades in positive territory around 1.3405 during the early European trading hours on Thursday. Fading political uncertainty in the United Kingdom (UK) provides some support to the British Pound (GBP) against the US Dollar (USD).
FX.reason: Technical/short-term GBP strength vs USD driven by lower UK political risk. Relevance limited by being a price-forecast note rather than a major macro policy shift.

FX.title: Japan’s Kihara says government aims to secure market trust by stably lowering debt-to-GDP ratio
FX.summary: Japan's Chief Cabinet Secretary Minoru Kihara said during the European trading session on Thursday that the administration wants to secure market trust by stably lowering the government debt-to-GDP ratio.
FX.reason: Fiscal credibility comments from senior Japanese official can support JPY via lower perceived sovereign risk — relevant to FX as it could alter flow/yield expectations for JPY crosses.

FX.title: USD/CAD Price Forecast: Hovers above 1.4150 as bullish bias prevails
FX.summary: USD/CAD moves sideways after two days of losses, trading around 1.4170 during the European hours on Thursday. The technical analysis of the daily chart indicates the pair is remaining within the ascending channel pattern, indicating a persistent bullish bias.
FX.reason: Technical USD/CAD note showing persistent USD bullish bias vs CAD. Relevance capped as a pair-level technical forecast; it also ties to commodity/cad flows but the article is primarily TA-focused.

Commodities.title: Goldman Says Hormuz Flare-Up May Delay Recovery in Oil Supplies
Commodities.reason: High-impact geopolitical escalation in the Strait of Hormuz that Goldman says could delay supply recovery — strong bullish oil supply-risk narrative, high relevance for crude and refined product markets.

Commodities.title: Oil prices jump more than 4% after Trump threatens to bomb Iran and reimpose naval blockade
Commodities.summary: Speaking at the NATO summit in Turkey, Trump said he considered the ceasefire with Iran over. His comments came after U.S. airstrikes overnight.
Commodities.reason: Large, market-moving price reaction to renewed U.S.-Iran hostilities and potential naval blockade — clear immediate upside pressure on oil and refined products.

Commodities.summary: U.S. petroleum exports reached a record in April as disruptions to international crude oil and refined product flows through the Strait of Hormuz increased global demand for U.S. exports. Exports increased to 13.6 million barrels per day (b/d) in April, 15% mo
Commodities.reason: EIA data showing record U.S. petroleum exports amid Hormuz disruptions supports tighter global supply and sustained demand for U.S. crude/refined products — constructive for oil prices.

Commodities.title: Oil: Rising geopolitical risks and Russian diesel ban – ING
Commodities.summary: ING analysts Warren Patterson and Ewa Manthey note that Oil has extended its rally as renewed US-Iran tensions threaten the fragile ceasefire and disrupt flows through the Strait of Hormuz.

Commodities.summary: Gold (XAU/USD) attracts some dip-buyers heading into the European session on Thursday and builds on the previous day's bounce from the $4,020 area, or a one-week low.
Commodities.reason: Precious-metal safe-haven buying from Middle East tensions and a softer USD provides upside for gold, though Fed rate-hike risks are a moderating factor — relevant for XAU/XAG.

Commodities.title: Silver Price Forecast: XAG/USD jumps to near $59 as US Dollar declines
Commodities.summary: Silver price (XAG/USD) is up over 1% to near $59.00 during the European trading session on Thursday. The white metal gains as the US Dollar (USD) faces selling pressure despite multiple tailwinds.
Commodities.reason: Short-term price/forecast piece tied to USD moves and risk cues — modest positive for silver but treated as lower-relevance technical/price-forecast content per framework.

Crypto.reason: Potential SEC rulemaking that explicitly eases fundraising for crypto startups is a material regulatory tailwind for the industry — likely to unlock capital and fundraising activity, supporting crypto risk assets broadly.

Crypto.title: BNB Chain is building a new layer-1 for high-frequency trading and AI agents

Crypto.reason: Validator support for a protocol upgrade improves network resilience and feature set for XRP; asset‑specific technical upgrades are constructive but limited in market‑wide impact.

Crypto.reason: Geopolitical escalation (U.S.-Iran tensions) triggered risk‑off selling across risk assets including crypto; such macro risk events are meaningful negatives for short‑term crypto demand and liquidity.
